shots.action: Night, inside the sloop: close on his face lit by his own torch, sea water spurting through the planks and rising round him, the lamp swinging hard
shots.camera: Close at eye level, easing in, rolling with the boat

shots.action: Out on the black swell: the little white sloop down by the bow, its cabin lights still on, sliding under; the black raft open on the water beside it
shots.camera: Low and wide from the water, drifting

shots.action: He tumbles in over the raft's tube with the emergency bag; the sloop's rail goes under behind him
shots.camera: Close on the raft, pushing in

shots.action: High and wide: the tiny raft alone where the sloop was; Rook drops onto the canopy and folds his wings
shots.camera: High wide, descending

shots.action: Rook on the tube pokes the rubber, it gives; he turns to us, unimpressed: 'A balloon? It'll pop first.'
shots.camera: Close on Rook, three-quarter, the dark swell behind

shots.action: Dawn: the raft and its orange canopy a speck on an endless ocean
shots.camera: Wide and low, slow push

shots.action: Close on the solar still riding beside the raft, drops running down inside
shots.camera: Close, easing in

shots.action: He sips from a tiny cup; Rook taps the still, then squints at how little is in the cup
shots.camera: Medium on Rook and the man in the raft

shots.action: Underwater looking up: the raft a dark disc against the bright surface, a school of dorado circling below it
shots.camera: Low under the school, looking up

shots.action: He leans out over the tube with the short spear gun, aiming down; Rook leans out beside him
shots.camera: Close from outside the raft, low

shots.action: Underwater: the spear shoots down and one dorado jerks away with it; the school scatters
shots.camera: Medium underwater

shots.action: A big freighter crosses the horizon; he stands and waves an orange cloth over his head
shots.camera: Low from the water behind the raft

shots.action: Rook on the canopy waves his arm in big arcs at the ship; it keeps going; his arm and his brim drop
shots.camera: Medium behind and beside Rook, the ship beyond

shots.action: Underwater, close on the raft's belly: a speared dorado thrashes and the spear point rips into the bottom tube; air pours out
shots.camera: Close underwater, pushing in

shots.action: In the raft: the bottom tube sags, water slops in, he grabs at the soft rubber
shots.camera: Medium from above the tube

shots.action: Rook standing on the tube as it folds under him: he drops to his knees and his hat jumps
shots.camera: Close on Rook

shots.action: Close on the hole: his hands press a patch over it; it bubbles and peels away
shots.camera: Close on the tube

shots.action: Rook plucks a feather and holds it over the hole; the air blows it straight off
shots.camera: Medium on Rook and the hole

shots.action: Close: his hands push a fork through the rubber round the hole and fold it shut; the bubbling stops
shots.camera: Close on the hands and the hole

shots.action: Weeks later under a white sun: he sits hunched and thin, beard long; Rook beside him, hat off
shots.camera: Medium on the two of them
shots.hud: A THIRD OF HIS WEIGHT GONE

shots.action: Night: from behind him, a low dark island on the horizon with a string of lights; he pulls himself up to look
shots.camera: Over his shoulder towards the island

shots.action: Rook on the canopy at night lifts his brim with one finger, the island's lights in his eyes
shots.camera: Close on Rook from the island side

shots.action: Morning, from high above: dark frigate birds wheel in a ring over the raft, gold fish flashing round it
shots.camera: High over the raft

shots.action: Low on the water: a small blue and yellow fishing boat with three men turns towards the birds
shots.camera: Low from the water

shots.action: Alongside: the fishermen take him by the arms and lift him out of the raft; Rook steadies the raft, hat off
shots.camera: Medium from the side, low

shots.action: Rook on the canopy points up at the birds, then straight down at the fish, and nods
shots.camera: Low on Rook, the birds above

shots.action: Underwater: the raft above, the fishing boat's hull sliding in beside it, the school still circling
shots.camera: Underwater, looking up

shots.action: Sunset, the empty raft drifting: Rook on its tube with the fork from the case, asking us straight out
shots.camera: Close on Rook

shots.action: Wide at sunset: the raft on a gold sea, Rook on the canopy tipping his hat, then pocketing the fork
shots.camera: Wide, slow pull back

shots.action: The opening shot played back to its first frame, so the end runs into the start
shots.camera: As the first shot
